def slugify(text):

    # Replace whitespace with a single hyphen
    text = re.sub(r'\s+', '-', text)
    # Remove all other non-alphanumeric characters (like +, !)
    text = re.sub(r'[^a-z0-9]+', '', text)
    return text.strip('-')


def truncate(text, n):

    return text[: n - 3] + "..."
